requirements.text: The system is free, replacing paid platforms like evento.com, offering specific functionalities for WEPGCOMP.
requirements.rationale: O stakeholder afirmou que o sistema é gratuito e evita recorrer a outras plataformas pagas.

requirements.text: The system shall be a web-based platform.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 states 'ambiente Web' (web environment), confirming the platform is web-based.

requirements.text: The system interface shall be available in Portuguese.
requirements.rationale: The transcript is entirely in Portuguese, indicating the primary language of communication and likely the interface language.

requirements.text: The system should ideally store PDF files in an external file system (not in the database) to avoid performance degradation.
requirements.rationale: O stakeholder explicitamente afirmou que salvar PDFs no banco de dados não é ideal e sugere um sistema de arquivos separado, mencionando que bancos com milhões de registros podem sofrer sintomas de performance.

requirements.text: As an administrator (comissão), I want to create and edit the event schedule, including sessions and presentation slots, so that I can organize the event program.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated the administrator can create and edit the event schedule and instructions.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want the system to generate distinct certificates for participation and award (best presentation), as a future improvement, so that each event is separated into different PDFs.
requirements.rationale: O stakeholder mencionou que certificados de participação e premiação devem ser fatorados em PDFs separados.

requirements.text: The system shall support up to approximately 70 users during the event period.
requirements.rationale: O stakeholder estimou que cerca de 70 pessoas usam o sistema durante o evento, indicando uma escala pequena e gerenciável.

requirements.text: As a system administrator, I want to store all event data (presentations, schedules, users) associated with a specific year/edition, so that the system maintains a historical record of each annual WEPGCOMP edition.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated that the system must maintain history of editions and that everything is associated with a specific year to preserve memory.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want the system to optionally support importing legacy data from spreadsheets, so that historical event information from previous editions can be migrated to the centralized platform.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned that legacy data was stored in spreadsheets and that the system provides a centralized historical space, implying a need to import that legacy data.

requirements.text: As a system user, I want the system to potentially provide dashboards and analytical views in the future, so that I can compare participation evolution, submitted works, defended works, and track doctoral students over the years.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly described the need for a dashboard area to compare evolution and track data across editions.

requirements.text: As a student presenter, I want to provide my CPF, advisor name, and registration number during registration, so that the system can uniquely identify and verify my affiliation.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specified that student presenters must provide CPF, advisor, and registration number, which involves personal data collection.

requirements.text: As a registered user, I want the system to allow download of uploaded presentation PDFs, so that attendees can read the presentation materials.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated that any registered person can download and read the uploaded presentation files.

requirements.text: The system shall handle approximately 70 concurrent users during the event week.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder estimated around 70 users (60 presenters + 10 committee + 20 extra voters) using the system during the event.

requirements.text: As a common user (conferencista), I want to log in with username and password, so that I can access the event information and view presentations.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly defined the common user profile and its basic login requirement.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want to review and edit presentations registered by students, so that I can ensure the correctness and quality of submissions.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder said the administrator can edit the works that were registered by students.

requirements.text: As a super user, I want to be able to add and remove any user from the system, so that I can manage the complete user lifecycle and access control.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated that the super user can include and remove users, which is a critical authorization function.

requirements.text: As a student presenter, I want to register my presentation with title, abstract, and upload a PDF, so that my work is included in the event program.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned that the student provides the slot information for the presentation.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want to configure the event start and end dates, so that registration and voting are restricted to within that period.
requirements.rationale: O administrador define as datas do evento, e fora delas não é possível realizar cadastro ou votação.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want the system to allow user registration with profiles: common, student presenter, administrator, and super user.
requirements.rationale: Os quatro perfis de usuário foram explicitamente listados pelo stakeholder.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want the system to require CPF for all user profiles during registration.
requirements.rationale: O stakeholder afirmou que todos os perfis devem informar CPF no cadastro.

requirements.text: As a registered user, I want the system to allow any registered user to download presentation files, so that authenticated participants can access uploaded documents.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder said 'any person registered can download', implying that unregistered users cannot, which is an access control requirement.

requirements.text: As a student, I want to register my presentation in the event schedule created by administrators, so that my work is associated with the correct event year and program.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 explicitly states that the student must register their work in a schedule created by administrators, associated with a specific year for memory.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want to reschedule presentations by dragging them to empty slots within the same session or moving entire sessions, so that I can handle presenter absences and optimize the schedule without changing the event's total days.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 explicitly describes the need to drag presentations and move sessions when slots are empty, with the constraint that the event's three days remain fixed.

requirements.text: As a system, I should optionally validate student enrollment numbers against UFBA's public API (if available), so that only legitimate UFBA students can register as presenters.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 mentions the possibility of using a UFBA API with a security token to verify enrollment, though it is considered a weak need due to lack of public API.

requirements.text: As an administrator, I want the system to be configurable for different events beyond WEPGCOMP, so that it can be reused as a customizable platform for any academic event.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 discusses the potential for the system to be remodeled for other events, implying a future requirement for flexibility and customization.
